Dear {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
What's on your wishlist for NetSuite? Do any of the following grab your attention?
Automate payment collections from all corridors your company is selling into Offer flexible payment methods and localized, digitized invoicing options to your clients Gain full transparency into payment status across all global receivables ‌
At Flywire, we help A/R and treasury teams get the most out of their NetSuite environment by integrating their global receivables workflow for a seamless end-of-period recon and reporting process. Furthermore, your clients are offered familiar payment options in their local currency with around-the-clock support. ‌
You can learn more about our NetSuite integration at our upcoming webinar <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/on-demand-webinar-do-more-within-netsuite-automate-your-global-receivables-and-reconciliation?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]> on Thursday, October 20th at 11:30am CT/12:30pm ET. Our team will be discussing innovative solutions for today’s A/R challenges, an overview of our NetSuite integration, and a live demonstration so you can see it in action.
Register Today! <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/on-demand-webinar-do-more-within-netsuite-automate-your-global-receivables-and-reconciliation?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=]]>
I hope to see you there! ‌
Thank You, Flywire for B2B
